**Issue #3349 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3349: Patch: unlocks worth the wait: a new variant level is revealed on its own card, Legendary and Mythic pulls take the screen, and the Collection shows off what you earned
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3345, whose full-screen view the biggest reveals open.

The owner wants the art's unlock system to feel very nice, so that the truly special cards stand out when you earn them.

### Today

- **Pack reveals** grow their effects with rarity (`revealCues`, `packs/PackOpening.tsx`; `PackOpening.test.tsx` "a reveal's effects grow with its rarity").
- **How cosmetics are earned** (§14.3 to §14.6):
  - a duplicate card's cosmetic roll (the next level of a variant, with `LEVEL_SKIP_WEIGHT`);
  - cosmetic packs;
  - Rare, Epic and Legendary cosmetic tokens;
  - the Chase Shard bar, which buys a Legendary or Mythic chase.
- **The gap.** The planner should check how each of these grants is shown today. This issue makes every one show the look itself, on its card, scaled to its rarity.

### What it should be

1. **A grant shows the look.** Whatever grants a variant level (a roll, a pack, a token, the chase), the reveal shows **the card wearing it**:
   - first in its previous look;
   - then a wipe into the new level: the full-art frame unfolding, the animation starting, the signature writing itself;
   - with the level's name and rarity under it.

   Several grants at once play in order, the rarest last.
2. **Scaled to its rarity:**
   - **Rare and Epic:** a reveal on the panel, with a sound by rarity.
   - **Legendary:** the panel dims, and the card grows in with light from behind and its intro sting (#3332).
   - **Mythic, or a Legendary or Mythic chase:** the card takes the screen in its full-screen view (#3345), the camera flying through it with its music. A tap moves on.
3. **Pack pulls.** A Legendary or Mythic card pulled from a pack gets its own moment beyond `revealCues`' growth: a Legendary's tile flares before it flips, and a Mythic's pack tears open into its takeover with its own art (#3345). A Common to Epic pull keeps today's reveal. The order of reveal is the pack's, and it never shows a slot before the player opens it.
4. **The Collection shows off.** A card with a newly earned level carries a "new" mark in the Collection until it is viewed. Its tile there previews the new look moving when hovered (the existing preview, #3016). The Collection's ladder shows each level's look on the card, not only its name.
5. **Settings.** Reduced motion shows each reveal as a still before and after, and `bigMoments` short or off shortens or stills the full-screen ones. A tap always moves on.

## Acceptance

- Tests: a roll, a pack, a token and a chase grant each show the card in its new level, rarest last, with the rarity's treatment.
- A Legendary and a Mythic pack pull play their own moments, and no slot shows before it is opened.
- The Collection's "new" mark appears and clears, and its ladder shows each level's look.
- A component spec captures a Rare, a Legendary and a Mythic grant and a Mythic pull at desktop size and at 390x844, and under reduced motion.
- Any ruling is in this issue's block, with the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`.
- The web tests, `typecheck`, `eslint` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass, and the pull request carries a `## Player note`.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42544651737)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Every variant-level grant (a duplicate's roll, a cosmetic-pack slot, a token redemption, a Chase Shard buy) plays an ordered reveal, rarest last, showing the card in its previous look and then wiping into the new level with its name and rarity. Rare and Epic play on the panel with a sound by rarity; Legendary dims the panel and grows the card in with light and its intro sting; Mythic (and a Legendary or Mythic chase) takes the screen in the full-screen view from #3345. Legendary and Mythic pack pulls get their own moments, the Collection marks newly earned levels until viewed and shows each ladder level's look, and reduced motion plus `bigMoments` short/off degrade every reveal to a still or a shortened moment that a tap always skips.

| `apps/web/src/collection/newLevels.ts` | new | `markNewLevels`, `seenLevels`, `clearSeen` (localStorage, per account) |

## Steps

1. In `spec/rulings/R3349000.md` write the ruling (lowest free number in issue #3349's block): grant reveals play rarest-last showing previous look then new level; Rare/Epic panel + sting, Legendary dim + grow-in + intro sting, Mythic and Legendary/Mythic chase full-screen with camera and music; Legendary pack flare and Mythic pack tear-into-takeover in pack order with no slot shown early; Collection new-mark until viewed and per-level looks; reduced motion stills and `bigMoments` short/off shortening with tap-to-skip. Cite `proven_in` as the three test files plus the component spec. In `spec/pending/3349.md` write the matching `**[[R3349000]] … (issue #3349, <date>)**` paragraph.
2. In `apps/web/src/packs/packs.ts` add `legendaryFlareCues(testid, intensity)` (gold rays + rising burst, mirroring `revealCues`' Legendary entry), `GRANT_TREATMENT` mapping each cosmetic rarity to `panel` (Rare/Epic), `grow` (Legendary), `takeover` (Mythic, plus any chase buy), and `orderGrantsRarestLast(items)` sorting by `RARITY_ORDER` index, stable for ties so pack order survives.
3. Create `apps/web/src/economy/GrantReveal.tsx` with `GrantItem { cosmeticId, cardId, below, rarity, chase }`: render the card in its previous level (`CosmeticLook` of the highest owned level below, else the normal face), then a wipe (`grantReveal.css` `--grant-wipe-ms`, copy the `PackObject` tear pattern) into the new level full-art frame with animation starting and signature drawing in (reuse `CardFace` + `CosmeticLook`), captioning level name and rarity. Props: `items` (already ordered), `onDone`; a tap advances (`onPointerUp` + `onClick`, keyboard Enter/Space). Rare/Epic call `playStinger(rarity)`; Legendary dims the panel (`data-treatment="grow"`), plays `entranceSting` (copy the import `apps/web/src/audio/cues.ts` uses); Mythic/chase renders `FullScreenArt` with `bigMoments` read from `getFxSettings()` (`short` = 500 ms hold, `off` = still frame, copy `TakeoverStill`'s data attributes); reduced motion (`useSetting("reduceMotion")` or `reducedMotionNow(fx)`) shows before/after stills only. Copy testid style from `packTestid`: export `grantTestid` with `scene`, `item(i)`, `before(i)`, `after(i)`, `name(i)`, `skip`.
4. In `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, in `PackScene`'s slots map: when a slot's grant is a cosmetic whose rarity is Legendary, play `legendaryFlareCues` on the sealed tile once the pack tears (before any flip); when a card pull's rarity is Mythic, replace the tear with the pack tearing open into `FullScreenArt` for that card's own art (import `takeoverArtOf` only for the backdrop class; the card art itself comes from `CATALOG`), closing to the slots grid on tap. Keep `shows()` gating so no slot renders face-up before its own flip or Reveal all. Reduced motion keeps today's instant all-revealed path.
5. In `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, collect the opened slots' cosmetic grants into ordered `GrantItem`s and render `GrantReveal` over the reveal list (rarest last; ties keep slot order); the `ShardBar` chase `confirm()` success renders `GrantReveal` with the single bought chase (treatment `grow` for Legendary, `takeover` for Legendary/Mythic chase per step 2) before the choice list closes. Keep the R2683000 ask-first dialog unchanged.
6. In `apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.tsx`, after `redeemCosmeticToken`/`redeemCardToken` resolves, render `GrantReveal` with the single bought cosmetic (cardId from the offer's props) instead of closing the preview at once; the preview closes on the reveal's `onDone`. Card-token buys (a new card, no level) keep today's close-and-reread path.
7. Create `apps/web/src/collection/newLevels.ts`: `markNewLevels(accountId, levelIds)` appending to localStorage key `jackioh.seen-levels.<accountId>` only ids not already stored; `seenLevels(accountId)` reading them; `clearSeen(accountId, levelIds)` removing viewed ones. In `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.tsx`, call `markNewLevels` from each grant site's success (pack scene close, cosmetic-pack open, token redeem, chase buy — pass the granted level ids through `onChanged`/`onClosed` callbacks already present), render a `data-new="true"` badge on `CollectionCardTile` for cards with unseen levels, and clear on opening that card's view or preview. Hover (`LookHover.tsx` `useLookHover`, #3016 pattern) previews the new level moving via `LookViews`; touch keeps today's hold-to-preview.
8. In `apps/web/src/collection/VariantLadders.tsx`, extend `RungPicture` so animated rungs set `data-cosmetic-motion="animated"` (copy `SampleFace`'s attribute logic) and signed rungs render `FullArtSignature` over the face (copy its use in `CardFace`); each rung keeps name + rarity caption. No change to `cardLadders` ordering.
9. Write the component spec `e2e/cypress/component/grant-reveals.cy.tsx` (copy `card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` structure): mount `GrantReveal` with a Rare, a Legendary, and a Mythic grant plus a Mythic pack pull; snapshot at 1280x720 and 390x844 and under reduced motion (stub `matchMedia` as `TakeoverStill.test.tsx` does). Assert wipe staging, treatment attributes, and tap-to-advance.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.test.tsx`: `it("R3349000 a Legendary pull flares before it flips")` (flare cue testid present after tear, slot still sealed); `it("R3349000 a Mythic pull tears into its takeover")` (FullScreenArt appears, tap returns to grid); `it("R3349000 no slot shows before it is opened")` (all `data-revealed="false"` after tear; order of flips is the pack's). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test PackOpening.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`: `it("R3349000 a cosmetic pack grant shows the card in its new level, rarest last")`; `it("R3349000 a chase buy takes the screen")`. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test Shop.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/collection/collection.test.tsx` (plus `OwnedCards` render tests in the same run): `it("R3349000 a new level marks the card until it is viewed")` (mark appears, opens view, mark clears); `it("R3349000 each ladder rung shows its level's look")` (motion/signature attributes per rung). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test collection.test.tsx`.
- Component spec: `E2E_COMPONENT_PORT=5282 pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/grant-reveals.cy.tsx`.
- Checks: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/economy/GrantReveal.tsx apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx apps/web/src/collection/`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Roll, pack, token, and chase grants each show the card in its new level, rarest last, with the rarity's treatment.
- [ ] Legendary and Mythic pack pulls play their moments; no slot shows before it is opened.
- [ ] Collection new-mark appears and clears; the ladder shows each level's look.
- [ ] Component spec captures Rare, Legendary, Mythic grants and a Mythic pull at desktop and 390x844 and under reduced motion.
- [ ] R3349000 note, `proven_in`, and `spec/pending/3349.md` paragraph exist; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] Web tests, typecheck, and eslint pass; the pull request carries a `## Player note`.

## Risks

- Reusing `FullScreenArt` inside two scenes (pack + grant) could double-mount its music intro: mitigate by rendering it in exactly one place per reveal (the `GrantReveal` owns it; `PackScene`'s Mythic path renders it directly and unmounts before the grid shows).
- Pack order vs rarest-last: pack pulls keep pack order (acceptance), only multi-grant moments sort rarest-last; `orderGrantsRarestLast` is stable and applied only to grant queues, never to pack slots.
- Hidden information (CLAUDE.md rule 7): reveals render only the server's answered grants; the new-mark store holds only ids the server already sent to this account.
- `bigMoments`/reduced-motion reads must match #3345's semantics (full/short/off; stills): read the same `getFxSettings()` + panel setting, never a new flag.

## Open questions

None. The one judgment call the task leaves open — whether the Mythic pack takeover reuses the card's own art or a generic burst — is settled by the task itself ("with its own art", #3345): use the card's own art via the existing takeover/full-screen art path.
```

## Goal

Every variant-level grant (a duplicate's roll, a cosmetic-pack slot, a token redemption, a Chase Shard buy) plays an ordered reveal, rarest last, showing the card in its previous look and then wiping into the new level with its name and rarity. Rare and Epic play on the panel with a sound by rarity; Legendary dims the panel and grows the card in with light and its intro sting; Mythic (and a Legendary or Mythic chase) takes the screen in the full-screen view from #3345. Legendary and Mythic pack pulls get their own moments, the Collection marks newly earned levels until viewed and shows each ladder level's look, and reduced motion plus `bigMoments` short/off degrade every reveal to a still or a shortened moment that a tap always skips.

| `apps/web/src/economy/grantReveal.css` | new | Wipe transition, panel dim, Legendary grow-in light, stills |
| `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx` | change | `PackScene`: Legendary flare-before-flip, Mythic tear-into-takeover, keep pack order and sealed slots |
| `apps/web/src/packs/packs.ts` | change | `legendaryFlareCues`, `GRANT_TREATMENT` rarity map, `orderGrantsRarestLast` |
| `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx` | change | Cosmetic-pack slots and `ShardBar` chase buy play `GrantReveal` |
| `apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.tsx` | change | After a successful redeem, open the `GrantReveal` for the bought level |
| `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.tsx` | change | `CollectionCardTile`: "new" mark, hover plays the new level moving |
| `apps/web/src/collection/newLevels.ts` | new | `markNewLevels`, `seenLevels`, `clearSeen` (localStorage, per account) |
| `apps/web/src/collection/VariantLadders.tsx` | change | `RungPicture`: every rung draws its own level's frame/motion/signature, not just its name |
| `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.test.tsx` | change | Legendary/Mythic pull moments, ordering, sealed-slot tests |
| `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx` | change | Cosmetic-pack grant, token grant, chase grant reveal tests |
| `apps/web/src/collection/collection.test.tsx` | change | New-mark appears/clears, ladder-look tests |
| `e2e/cypress/component/grant-reveals.cy.tsx` | new | Component spec: Rare/Legendary/Mythic grants + Mythic pull, desktop + 390x844 + reduced motion |
| `spec/rulings/R3349000.md` | new | Ruling: grant reveals scale with rarity; Collection new-mark; settings degrade |
| `spec/pending/3349.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for R3349000 |

## Steps

1. In `spec/rulings/R3349000.md` write the ruling (lowest free number in issue #3349's block): grant reveals play rarest-last showing previous look then new level; Rare/Epic panel + sting, Legendary dim + grow-in + intro sting, Mythic and Legendary/Mythic chase full-screen with camera and music; Legendary pack flare and Mythic pack tear-into-takeover in pack order with no slot shown early; Collection new-mark until viewed and per-level looks; reduced motion stills and `bigMoments` short/off shortening with tap-to-skip. Cite `proven_in` as the three test files plus the component spec. In `spec/pending/3349.md` write the matching `**[[R3349000]] … (issue #3349, <date>)**` paragraph.
2. In `apps/web/src/packs/packs.ts` add `legendaryFlareCues(testid, intensity)` (gold rays + rising burst, mirroring `revealCues`' Legendary entry), `GRANT_TREATMENT` mapping each cosmetic rarity to `panel` (Rare/Epic), `grow` (Legendary), `takeover` (Mythic, plus any chase buy), and `orderGrantsRarestLast(items)` sorting by `RARITY_ORDER` index, stable for ties so pack order survives.
3. Create `apps/web/src/economy/GrantReveal.tsx` with `GrantItem { cosmeticId, cardId, below, rarity, chase }`: render the card in its previous level (`CosmeticLook` of the highest owned level below, else the normal face), then a wipe (`grantReveal.css` `--grant-wipe-ms`, copy the `PackObject` tear pattern) into the new level full-art frame with animation starting and signature drawing in (reuse `CardFace` + `CosmeticLook`), captioning level name and rarity. Props: `items` (already ordered), `onDone`; a tap advances (`onPointerUp` + `onClick`, keyboard Enter/Space). Rare/Epic call `playStinger(rarity)`; Legendary dims the panel (`data-treatment="grow"`), plays `entranceSting` (copy the import `apps/web/src/audio/cues.ts` uses); Mythic/chase renders `FullScreenArt` with `bigMoments` read from `getFxSettings()` (`short` = 500 ms hold, `off` = still frame, copy `TakeoverStill`'s data attributes); reduced motion (`useSetting("reduceMotion")` or `reducedMotionNow(fx)`) shows before/after stills only. Copy testid style from `packTestid`: export `grantTestid` with `scene`, `item(i)`, `before(i)`, `after(i)`, `name(i)`, `skip`.
4. In `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx`, in `PackScene`'s slots map: when a slot's grant is a cosmetic whose rarity is Legendary, play `legendaryFlareCues` on the sealed tile once the pack tears (before any flip); when a card pull's rarity is Mythic, replace the tear with the pack tearing open into `FullScreenArt` for that card's own art (import `takeoverArtOf` only for the backdrop class; the card art itself comes from `CATALOG`), closing to the slots grid on tap. Keep `shows()` gating so no slot renders face-up before its own flip or Reveal all. Reduced motion keeps today's instant all-revealed path.
5. In `apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx`, collect the opened slots' cosmetic grants into ordered `GrantItem`s and render `GrantReveal` over the reveal list (rarest last; ties keep slot order); the `ShardBar` chase `confirm()` success renders `GrantReveal` with the single bought chase (treatment `grow` for Legendary, `takeover` for Legendary/Mythic chase per step 2) before the choice list closes. Keep the R2683000 ask-first dialog unchanged.
6. In `apps/web/src/collection/TokenOffer.tsx`, after `redeemCosmeticToken`/`redeemCardToken` resolves, render `GrantReveal` with the single bought cosmetic (cardId from the offer's props) instead of closing the preview at once; the preview closes on the reveal's `onDone`. Card-token buys (a new card, no level) keep today's close-and-reread path.
7. Create `apps/web/src/collection/newLevels.ts`: `markNewLevels(accountId, levelIds)` appending to localStorage key `jackioh.seen-levels.<accountId>` only ids not already stored; `seenLevels(accountId)` reading them; `clearSeen(accountId, levelIds)` removing viewed ones. In `apps/web/src/collection/OwnedCards.tsx`, call `markNewLevels` from each grant site's success (pack scene close, cosmetic-pack open, token redeem, chase buy — pass the granted level ids through `onChanged`/`onClosed` callbacks already present), render a `data-new="true"` badge on `CollectionCardTile` for cards with unseen levels, and clear on opening that card's view or preview. Hover (`LookHover.tsx` `useLookHover`, #3016 pattern) previews the new level moving via `LookViews`; touch keeps today's hold-to-preview.
8. In `apps/web/src/collection/VariantLadders.tsx`, extend `RungPicture` so animated rungs set `data-cosmetic-motion="animated"` (copy `SampleFace`'s attribute logic) and signed rungs render `FullArtSignature` over the face (copy its use in `CardFace`); each rung keeps name + rarity caption. No change to `cardLadders` ordering.
9. Write the component spec `e2e/cypress/component/grant-reveals.cy.tsx` (copy `card-fullscreen.cy.tsx` structure): mount `GrantReveal` with a Rare, a Legendary, and a Mythic grant plus a Mythic pack pull; snapshot at 1280x720 and 390x844 and under reduced motion (stub `matchMedia` as `TakeoverStill.test.tsx` does). Assert wipe staging, treatment attributes, and tap-to-advance.

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.test.tsx`: `it("R3349000 a Legendary pull flares before it flips")` (flare cue testid present after tear, slot still sealed); `it("R3349000 a Mythic pull tears into its takeover")` (FullScreenArt appears, tap returns to grid); `it("R3349000 no slot shows before it is opened")` (all `data-revealed="false"` after tear; order of flips is the pack's). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test PackOpening.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/shop/Shop.test.tsx`: `it("R3349000 a cosmetic pack grant shows the card in its new level, rarest last")`; `it("R3349000 a chase buy takes the screen")`. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test Shop.test.tsx`.
- `apps/web/src/collection/collection.test.tsx` (plus `OwnedCards` render tests in the same run): `it("R3349000 a new level marks the card until it is viewed")` (mark appears, opens view, mark clears); `it("R3349000 each ladder rung shows its level's look")` (motion/signature attributes per rung). Run `pnpm --dir apps/web test collection.test.tsx`.
- Component spec: `E2E_COMPONENT_PORT=5282 pnpm --dir e2e test:component --spec cypress/component/grant-reveals.cy.tsx`.
- Checks: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/economy/GrantReveal.tsx apps/web/src/packs/PackOpening.tsx apps/web/src/shop/CosmeticPacks.tsx apps/web/src/collection/`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] Roll, pack, token, and chase grants each show the card in its new level, rarest last, with the rarity's treatment.
- [ ] Legendary and Mythic pack pulls play their moments; no slot shows before it is opened.
- [ ] Collection new-mark appears and clears; the ladder shows each level's look.
- [ ] Component spec captures Rare, Legendary, Mythic grants and a Mythic pull at desktop and 390x844 and under reduced motion.
- [ ] R3349000 note, `proven_in`, and `spec/pending/3349.md` paragraph exist; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] Web tests, typecheck, and eslint pass; the pull request carries a `## Player note`.

## Risks

- Reusing `FullScreenArt` inside two scenes (pack + grant) could double-mount its music intro: mitigate by rendering it in exactly one place per reveal (the `GrantReveal` owns it; `PackScene`'s Mythic path renders it directly and unmounts before the grid shows).
- Pack order vs rarest-last: pack pulls keep pack order (acceptance), only multi-grant moments sort rarest-last; `orderGrantsRarestLast` is stable and applied only to grant queues, never to pack slots.
- Hidden information (CLAUDE.md rule 7): reveals render only the server's answered grants; the new-mark store holds only ids the server already sent to this account.
- `bigMoments`/reduced-motion reads must match #3345's semantics (full/short/off; stills): read the same `getFxSettings()` + panel setting, never a new flag.

## Open questions

None. The one judgment call the task leaves open — whether the Mythic pack takeover reuses the card's own art or a generic burst — is settled by the task itself ("with its own art", #3345): use the card's own art via the existing takeover/full-screen art path.
